entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'representative' to speak with an agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to process a return for an order I received a few weeks ago.
I can certainly help with that. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
The name is Sam Jones, order number is VF789012.
Thank you, Sam. Pulling that up now... I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. It looks like it was delivered 24 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that's the one. And just so you know, the box is still sealed. It's a completely unopened box.

Not a problem at all. I see here that you are well within the 90-day return window for standard items. I've just gone ahead and approved that return for you. I'm emailing you the return shipping label right now.

Excellent, that was easy. Thank you. Now, since I am returning it unused and I'm a VIP member, is there any possibility of getting a discount code for a future purchase? The color wasn't quite what I expected and I'll need to order a different one.

I understand completely. Getting the right color is important. And I do see your VIP status here. We definitely want to make sure you're happy with your gear, especially when it comes to something as critical as safety. For the inconvenience, I can add a 15% discount code to your account that you can use on your next helmet.
A 15% discount works for me. I appreciate you doing that, Alex. That's a perfect solution.
You're very welcome, Sam. The code has been applied to your account, and that return label is in your inbox. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and ride safely!
